name: Beesten (Germany)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Beesten (a red chevron with lozenges and a wheel on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Beesten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Beesten arms — red chevron and wheel on yellow
